chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-Kūfī, from ʿUbays ibn Hishām, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sulaymān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
Surely in that there are signs for those who discern.
So he said: They are the Imams عليهم السلام.
And surely it is on an enduring way.
He said: It will never depart from us.

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةُ: the Imams, the divinely guided leaders
key_terms.الْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ: those who discern signs and perceive with insight
key_terms.بِسَبِيلٍ مُقِيمٍ: upon an abiding and lasting way
key_terms.لَا يَخْرُجُ: does not depart or go out

ai.seo_question: Who are the mutawassimīn mentioned in the Qur'an according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic verse by identifying the mutawassimīn as the Imams عليهم السلام. It further states that the abiding way remains among them and never departs from them, emphasizing their enduring role as divinely designated guides.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Ubeys Bin Hisham, from Abdullah Bin Suleyman, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [15:75]
Surely, in this are Signs for the distinguishers (of the marks).
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They<sup>asws</sup> are the Imams<sup>asws</sup>’.
(And for) [15:76] And surely it is on a road that still abides
, he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It will not exit from us<sup>asws</sup>, ever!’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi from ‘Ubays ibn Hisham from ‘Adallah ibn Sulayman from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following about the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High.
“In this there is evidence (of the Truth) for the distinguished ones.” [15:75]
The Imams (a.s.) said, “These people are the Imams (a.s.)
